reddit.title: Improving Colony Music Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant updates to how music plays in Provincia! No more jarring transitions between day, night, title, and combat music. Our new AI-authored loops use a smooth crossfade to enhance your gameplay experience. Check out the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

posts: Exciting news for our music system! We've implemented a long equal-power crossfade for smoother transitions between different music beds. Learn more about this improvement: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

Our latest update enhances the audio experience in Provincia with seamless transitions in music. Discover how we've tackled the previous hitch issues: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Audio Improvements in Provincia
steam.body: We've revamped the audio system in Provincia to provide a smoother musical experience. With our new self-crossfade feature, transitions between different music beds are now seamless, enhancing your gameplay immersion. Read more about these changes and other updates here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
